about: Weights for scoring trap-stacking designs (STACKING-EXPLORATION.md §3-§5). Separate from sourcer/weights.json, which scores hosts and advisories for the other task types. Not related to sourcer/stacking_screener.py (Branch C co-presence).

tier_miss_probability._note: Per-run chance that a model leaves a trap of this tier open. Initial priors from SIBLING-INJECTION-PATTERNS.md (miss rates per mechanism among trialled siblings) and the xhard cases (sib catch-all DS 6/6, electron-builder-ds T4 DS 9/9). Refit from docs/research/trap_tally.tsv after each batch.

kind_prior_tier._note: Default tier when the reader gives none. Source: miss rates per mechanism among trialled siblings (2026-10-20 analysis).

site_factor._note: D3. Extra per-run chance that one more location of an accepted concept is missed. Small, because a model that accepts a concept fixes its sites together (sib7: 10/10).

correlation_rule: Traps in one independent group (closed by one guard or fix site) are one concept: take the group's highest miss probability, plus the site factor.

single_carry_warning._note: Flag a design when, for some model, P_fail3 without that model's hardest concept falls below this. Calibrated 2026-10-22: jackson-databind-sib2 (every run failed 2+ parts) stays above it (0.29 / 0.24); jackson-databind-sib and prompty (one trap each) fall below it.

learning_loop: After each batch: refit tier_miss_probability and kind_prior_tier per model from the trap tally, bump the version, re-score.
